name: 02_config_env_with_export
why: The backups that still worked had `export` on every line, and `hermes memory setup` writes it too. The prefix is shell syntax, not part of the key name: both loaders must strip it and must NOT end up with a variable literally called `export ANHUR_API_KEY`.
on_failure: One loader stopped stripping `export `. If the fingerprint is empty, that plugin reads no key at all and persists NOTHING while still exiting 0.
